From 6b0856ee585d7f8a544546c3c5f1f4c49162e451 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Samuel Holland <samuel.holland@sifive.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Apr 2024 16:22:03 -0700
Subject: [PATCH] cache: sifive_ccache: Silence unused variable warning

With W=1 and CONFIG_RISCV_NONSTANDARD_CACHE_OPS=n, GCC warns:

drivers/cache/sifive_ccache.c: In function 'sifive_ccache_init':
drivers/cache/sifive_ccache.c:293:23: warning: variable 'quirks' set but not used [-Wunused-but-set-variable]
  293 |         unsigned long quirks;
      |                       ^~~~~~

This is expected, since QUIRK_NONSTANDARD_CACHE_OPS is the only quirk
still handled in this function.

Fixes: c90847bcbfb6 ("cache: sifive_ccache: Partially convert to a platform driver")
Reported-by: kernel test robot <lkp@intel.com>
Closes: https://lore.kernel.org/oe-kbuild-all/202403311253.Z4NvIBxI-lkp@intel.com/
Signed-off-by: Samuel Holland <samuel.holland@sifive.com>
Signed-off-by: Conor Dooley <conor.dooley@microchip.com>

diff --git a/drivers/cache/sifive_ccache.c b/drivers/cache/sifive_ccache.c
index e9cc8b4786fb..6874b72ec59d 100644
--- a/drivers/cache/sifive_ccache.c
+++ b/drivers/cache/sifive_ccache.c
@@ -290,7 +290,7 @@ static int __init sifive_ccache_init(void)
 	struct device_node *np;
 	struct resource res;
 	const struct of_device_id *match;
-	unsigned long quirks;
+	unsigned long quirks __maybe_unused;
 	int rc;
 
 	np = of_find_matching_node_and_match(NULL, sifive_ccache_ids, &match);
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

**File: `drivers/cache/sifive_ccache.c`**
- The variable `quirks` was modified from:
  ```c
  unsigned long quirks;
  ```
  to:
  ```c
  unsigned long quirks __maybe_unused;
  ```
  This change marks the `quirks` variable as potentially unused, which suppresses the compiler warning about it being set but not used.

### Relationships
The modification addresses a specific compiler warning that arises when the `CONFIG_RISCV_NONSTANDARD_CACHE_OPS` configuration is set to `n`. By marking the `quirks` variable as `__maybe_unused`, the patch resolves the warning without altering the functionality of the code. This change is part of a broader effort to clean up the codebase and improve compilation warnings, as indicated by the reported issue and the fix reference.

You are a programming expert.

The code statements that lead to the bug are:
```c
unsigned long quirks;
```
```c
quirks = (uintptr_t)match->data;
```
```c
#ifdef CONFIG_RISCV_NONSTANDARD_CACHE_OPS
```
Reason:
The variable `quirks` is declared but not used in the function when `CONFIG_RISCV_NONSTANDARD_CACHE_OPS` is set to `n`. This results in a compiler warning about the variable being set but not utilized, as the only quirk handled in the function is `QUIRK_NONSTANDARD_CACHE_OPS`, which is not relevant when the configuration is disabled.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```c
unsigned long quirks __maybe_unused;
```
Reason:
By adding the `__maybe_unused` attribute to the declaration of `quirks`, the compiler is informed that this variable may not be used, thus silencing the warning. This allows the code to compile without warnings while maintaining the variable's declaration for potential future use or configurations where it might be relevant.
